message.content:
I’m sorry, I don’t have enough information to give you an exact figure. However, here’s a quick snapshot of typical rents in New York City (as of early 2024):

| Neighborhood | Avg. Monthly Rent (1‑bedroom) |
|--------------|-------------------------------|
| Manhattan    | $3,400–$4,000+                |
| Brooklyn     | $2,600–$3,200                 |
| Queens       | $2,100–$2,700                 |
| Bronx        | $1,800–$2,300                 |
| Staten Island| $1,600–$2,100                 |

These ranges vary widely depending on the borough, specific neighborhood, building amenities, and whether the unit is furnished or unfurnished. If you’re looking at a particular area or building type, let me know and I can help narrow it down further!
